title: HTTP ingest API
summary: Send events over HTTPS, singly or in batches of 5,000.
body: The reference source. Every other source ends up as the same event shape.

title: PostgreSQL change capture
summary: Meter rows as they are written, from logical replication — no code change in your app.
body: Point Abacene at a publication; map columns to meter, customer, quantity and idempotency key.
setup: CREATE PUBLICATION abacene_usage FOR TABLE api_requests;

title: Apache Kafka
summary: Consume usage events from a topic with at-least-once delivery; duplicates dropped on key.
body: Consumer groups per meter family. Offsets are committed after events are durably recorded.
setup:
topic: usage.events
key:   idempotency_key
value: JSON event

title: OpenTelemetry
summary: Turn OTLP spans or metrics into meter events with a mapping rule.
body: Beta. Useful when usage is already instrumented as spans.

title: SFTP file drops
summary: Daily CSV or JSONL files from partners, picked up and metered with their own late window.
body: Pairs well with a per-meter late window of several days.

title: .NET SDK
summary: Typed client for .NET 8+, with batching, retries and idempotency keys built in.
body: Batches in the background and flushes on shutdown.
setup:
var abacene = new AbaceneClient(key);
await abacene.Events.SendAsync(new MeterEvent("api.calls", customerId, 1, requestId));

title: Python SDK
summary: Sync and async clients with batching and retries.
body: Works in web workers and batch jobs.

title: Go SDK
summary: Lightweight client with a background batcher.

title: S3-compatible export
summary: Daily export of raw events, aggregates and invoices as Parquet or JSONL to any S3-compatible bucket.
body: Your data, in your bucket, every day.

title: Apache Iceberg tables
summary: Write aggregates and invoice lines as Iceberg tables for your warehouse.

title: SAML and OpenID Connect SSO
summary: SSO for dashboard users with group-to-role mapping.

title: Webhooks
summary: Signed webhooks for invoice finalized, credit thresholds and late adjustments.
body: HMAC-SHA256 signatures; retries back off up to 24 hours.

title: Prometheus metrics
summary: Scrape ingest rate, lag and rejected events for your own dashboards.

title: Accounting journal export
summary: Journal entries per invoice as CSV or over SFTP, mapped to your chart of accounts.
